items.text: Once you have saved for twenty months, the bonus is yours to keep.

The PS deduction is 5,000 euros, and the withdrawal ceiling is 10,000 euros.
The deposit interest rate is 2 % and the bonus is 4 %.
ASP is a home savings account. Interest of 1 % is credited every 31 December. The 4 % bonus is paid later, after 20 approved monthly deposits and when you take a loan to buy a home.

items.request: Explain ASP using my monthly saving of 400 euros.
items.text: Your 400 euros a month sits inside the 50 to 1,500 euro range, and you would reach 20 deposits after 20 months. The bonus also needs a home loan.

items.request: Explain PS using my savings balance.
items.text: Your 14 600 euro savings balance is not what the PS rule looks at, that is the PS balance. If your PS balance is 5,000 euros or less on 1 January 2027, you can withdraw it in 2027 or 2028 without the higher rate.
For 2026 you can still deduct up to 5,000 euros of payments. From 2027 that right is gone, and I have not changed anything on your accounts.
I can explain how ASP works but I can't open one for you. You would do that online or in the app, and you have 14 days to cancel.
For new payments after the start of 2027 the 30 % tax is on the return only. Savings from before that are taxed on capital and return at 30 % when withdrawn.
A break in saving is allowed, since deposits need not be consecutive. It just delays the 20th deposit.
Closing the account for other use means 30 % tax is taken at source and no bonus is paid.
